text: DSH Plugin Workbench 是一款面向 Web 客户端的 DSH 插件，在右侧栏加入工作台标签，并通过主机服务和模型工具管理工作项。它为每个工作区保存独立待办，支持标题、描述和标签的模糊搜索、状态与归档筛选、卡片内编辑、归档恢复、复制为 Markdown，以及将待办发送到会话并由模型写回完成摘要和变更文件。适合希望在 DSH 会话中整理项目任务并跟踪模型完成情况的用户。代码未声明额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Plugin Workbench adds a workspace-based todo tab to DSH's web sidebar. Search, filter, edit, archive, and copy items as Markdown; send a todo into a conversation and save the model's completion back to it. No extra API keys or external services are declared.
我想按工作区整理 DSH 里的项目待办，并能快速搜索它们。
能不能在侧边栏编辑任务描述、加标签，再把已完成的任务归档？
I want the model to finish a tracked work item and save its completion back to the workspace list.
DSH Plugin Workbench 的功能「工作区待办搜索」：在模型工具或右侧工作台中按标题、描述和标签模糊查找当前工作区的工作项，并可按状态、标签和归档范围筛选。空查询可列出全部项目。
DSH Plugin Workbench 的功能「模型完成回写」：从待办卡片发起写回后，工作项进入处理流程；模型完成时将摘要、实现步骤和变更文件写入工作项，并更新完成状态。

dsh-plugin-workbench README · dsh-plugin-workbench：A work-item workbench in the DSH right Sidebar: every workspace keeps its own list of work
items, searchable and editable in place, with a write-back loop that lets the model finish
them.

[中文 README](README.zh.md)

dsh-plugin-workbench README · What it does：- **Per-workspace work items.** Items live in the workspace the conversation belongs to;
  switching conversations switches the list. Nothing shows when a session is outside a
  workspace.
- **Fuzzy search.** One box searches title, description, and tag, scoring prefix > substring >
  subsequence, then falls back to recency.
- **Four filters with counts.** 全部 / 未完成 / 已完成 / 已归档 (`all / active / done /
  archived`), plus a filter-aware empty state.
- **In-place editing.** Create, rename, edit the description, set a tag, and archive an item
  (reversible: the same button restores it). An item's status is written by the write-back
  loop, not by hand.
- **Write-back.** Sending an item as 待办总结 (`write-back`) posts it into the conversation;
  the model's reply is written back onto the item, which completes itself. The request is
  idempotent, so a retry cannot duplicate a completion.
- **Small conveniences.** Copy an item as Markdown, or fill its title into the composer.
- **Bilingual.** zh-CN and en-US UI strings ship with the plugin.

dsh-plugin-workbench README · Requirements：| | |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (declared as `engines.dsh`; the profile's compatibility check reads it) |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |

The DSH peer dependencies are pinned to exact `0.2.1-rc.2` versions on purpose: pnpm
resolves prerelease ranges unpredictably, so a range would install a mix of versions.

dsh-plugin-workbench README · From GitHub：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/Mr-Maidong/dsh-plugin-workbench.git
```

pnpm fetches the repository as a tarball. The built `packages/workbench/lib` is committed, so
the install needs no build step — which also matters because pnpm blocks build scripts for
git-hosted packages unless each exact tarball URL is allowlisted in the profile.

dsh-plugin-workbench README · From a local clone：```bash
git clone https://github.com/Mr-Maidong/dsh-plugin-workbench.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-workbench
```

dsh-plugin-workbench README · Restart DSH：The Host half is loaded during boot, so a freshly installed plugin only appears after a
restart. Client-side edits alone need nothing more than a page refresh.

dsh-plugin-workbench README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-workbench
```

> **Before uninstalling a local-path install, back the clone up.** pnpm installs a directory
> as a link (junction), and profile cleanup has been observed to follow such a link and delete
> files inside the linked directory. See `DESIGN.md` §0 for the incident.

dsh-plugin-workbench README · Usage：1. Open the right Sidebar and pick the 工作台 (`Workbench`) tab.
2. `+` creates an item in the current workspace; the search box and the filter row sit above
   the list.
3. Click a card's description to edit it inline: `Enter` commits, `Shift+Enter` adds a line,
   `Esc` reverts.
4. `待办总结` sends the item into the conversation. When the model answers, the answer is
   appended as the item's completion and the item moves to 已完成.

dsh-plugin-workbench README · Storage：Items are stored through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain` in the workspace's own domain, so
they travel with the workspace and never leak across workspaces.

dsh-plugin-workbench README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build          # tsc + tsdown for the Host half and the browser half
pnpm test           # 164 tests / 33 suites on Node's built-in runner
pnpm typecheck

`packages/workbench/lib` is committed because that is what an install consumes: rebuild it and
commit it together with any source change, or a fresh install keeps loading the old output.

dsh-plugin-workbench README · Development：- Host half: `packages/workbench/src/index.ts` → `lib/index.js`.
- Browser half: `packages/workbench/src/client/**` → `lib/client.js`.
- The Typert manifests in `src/typert.host.ts` and `src/typert.remote-client.ts` are written by
  hand because the upstream generator cannot analyze a plugin outside the DSH monorepo;
  `tests/remote-contract.spec.ts` holds them to the shipped Remote contract, including the
  manifest shape the runtime loader requires.
- `prototype/` holds the static HTML prototypes the UI was designed against, and `repro/` a
  mounting harness.
dsh-plugin-workbench README · License：MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
